 RETURNS text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mp_ambush_orders(p_fleet_id text, p_orders jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare m text := coalesce(p_orders ->> 'mode', 'manual');
begin
  if m not in ('manual', 'rob_heavy', 'rob_all', 'spy') then m := 'manual'; end if;
  update public.ambushes
     set orders = jsonb_build_object('mode', m, 'players', m <> 'manual' and coalesce((p_orders ->> 'players')::boolean, false))
   where user_id = auth.uid() and fleet_id = p_fleet_id and left_at is null;
  return found;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mp_beacon_scan()
 RETURNS TABLE(convoy_id uuid, system text, pseudo text, address text, confidence integer, tanker_tier integer, cargo_hint text, window_end timestamp with time zone, leg text, dock_name text, route_type text, can_intercept boolean, spied boolean, next_system text, on_route boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with mine as (select distinct b.system from public.beacons b where b.user_id = auth.uid() and b.removed_at is null),
  cand as (
    select c as cv, m.system as at_system
      from public.convoys c join mine m
        on (m.system = c.from_system or m.system = c.to_system or (c.via is not null and c.via @> array[m.system]))
     where c.status = 'enroute' and c.user_id <> auth.uid() and now() < c.arrives_at
  ),
  seen as (
    select (k.cv).*, k.at_system,
           public._mp_convoy_window(k.cv, k.at_system) as wend,
           public._mp_convoy_next(k.cv, k.at_system) as nxt
      from cand k
  )
  select s.id, s.at_system,
         case when s.route_type = 'beacon' then null else s.pseudo end,
         null::text,                                       -- l'adresse ne se lit pas au passage : il faut espionner la route
         case when s.route_type = 'beacon' then 40 else 60 + ((hashtext(s.id::text)::bigint % 31) + 31) % 31 end,
         s.tanker_tier,
         case when coalesce((s.cargo ->> 'metal')::bigint, 0) + coalesce((s.cargo ->> 'energie')::bigint, 0) + coalesce((s.cargo ->> 'cristal')::bigint, 0) = 0 then 'vide'
              when (coalesce((s.cargo ->> 'metal')::bigint, 0) + coalesce((s.cargo ->> 'energie')::bigint, 0) + coalesce((s.cargo ->> 'cristal')::bigint, 0))
                   > public._mp_cargo_cap(s.tanker_tier) / 2 then 'lourde' else 'légère' end,
         s.wend, s.leg, s.dock_name, s.route_type,
         exists (select 1 from public.ambushes a where a.user_id = auth.uid() and a.left_at is null and a.system = s.at_system),
         exists (select 1 from public.spied sp where sp.pirate_id = auth.uid() and sp.convoy_id = s.id),
         s.nxt,
         s.own_route
    from seen s
   where s.wend is not null
   order by s.wend
   limit 30
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mp_claim_intercepts(p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(intercept_id uuid, ambush jsonb, convoy jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  -- interceptions restées bloquées (fonction interrompue) : remises dans la file
  update public.intercepts set status = 'pending' where status = 'resolving' and claimed_at < now() - interval '5 minutes';
  return query
  with due as (
    select i.id from public.intercepts i where i.status = 'pending' order by i.created_at limit p_limit for update skip locked
  ), upd as (
    update public.intercepts i set status = 'resolving', claimed_at = now() from due where i.id = due.id returning i.*
  )
  select u.id, to_jsonb(a), to_jsonb(c)
    from upd u join public.ambushes a on a.id = u.ambush_id join public.convoys c on c.id = u.convoy_id;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mp_posts_visible()
 RETURNS TABLE(system text, pseudo text, address text, tanker_name text, opened_at timestamp with time zone, met boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with mine_posts as (select distinct p.system from public.route_posts p where p.user_id = auth.uid() and p.left_at is null),
  eyes as (
    select system from mine_posts
    union
    select distinct b.system from public.beacons b where b.user_id = auth.uid() and b.removed_at is null
  )
  select p.system, p.pseudo, p.address, p.tanker_name, p.opened_at, exists (select 1 from mine_posts m where m.system = p.system)
    from public.route_posts p join eyes e on e.system = p.system
   where p.left_at is null and p.user_id <> auth.uid()
   order by p.opened_at desc
   limit 40
$function$

create table public.ambushes (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() not null,
  user_id uuid not null,
  pseudo text not null,
  fleet_id text not null,
  fleet_name text,
  system text not null,
  fleet jsonb not null,
  hold jsonb default '{}'::jsonb not null,
  hold_claimed boolean default false not null,
  posted_at timestamp with time zone default now() not null,
  left_at timestamp with time zone,
  orders jsonb default '{}'::jsonb not null,
  npc_keys ARRAY default '{}'::text[] not null
);

create table public.beacons (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() not null,
  user_id uuid not null,
  local_id text not null,
  system text not null,
  placed_at timestamp with time zone default now() not null,
  removed_at timestamp with time zone
);

create table public.convoys (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() not null,
  user_id uuid not null,
  pseudo text not null,
  address text not null,
  mission_id text not null,
  leg text not null,
  kind text not null,
  from_system text not null,
  to_system text not null,
  dock_name text,
  route_type text default 'direct'::text not null,
  knowledge integer default 0 not null,
  protection numeric default 0 not null,
  tanker_tier integer default 1 not null,
  tanker_name text,
  cargo jsonb default '{}'::jsonb not null,
  departed_at timestamp with time zone default now() not null,
  arrives_at timestamp with time zone not null,
  status text default 'enroute'::text not null,
  loot jsonb,
  outcome text,
  loss_mode text,
  intercept_system text,
  cancelled boolean default false not null,
  pirate_id uuid,
  pirate_pseudo text,
  spied_since timestamp with time zone,
  seen boolean default false not null,
  via ARRAY,
  own_route boolean default false not null
);

create table public.intercepts (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() not null,
  ambush_id uuid not null,
  convoy_id uuid not null,
  pirate_id uuid not null,
  victim_id uuid not null,
  status text default 'pending'::text not null,
  result jsonb,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now() not null,
  claimed_at timestamp with time zone,
  resolved_at timestamp with time zone,
  seen boolean default false not null
);

create table public.route_posts (
  id uuid default gen_random_uuid() not null,
  user_id uuid not null,
  pseudo text not null,
  address text not null,
  mission_id text not null,
  system text not null,
  tanker_name text,
  route_name text,
  opened_at timestamp with time zone default now() not null,
  left_at timestamp with time zone
);
